#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
exec 2>&1
bird -p -c /var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-baseline.conf
cp -p /var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-baseline.conf /etc/bird/bird.conf
birdc configure
cmp -s /var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-baseline.conf /etc/bird/bird.conf

echo SOURCE_BEGIN
date -u +%FT%TZ
sha256sum /etc/bird/bird.conf /var/lib/threehub/aspath-jp-baseline.conf
birdc show protocols
echo EXPORT_BEGIN
birdc show route export azure_0 all
echo EXPORT_END
echo SOURCE_END
